name: Watercolor Storybook: Character Full Body
description: Image preset for a character full body in the Watercolor Storybook look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a full-body design view. Describe build, default outfit, signature accessory, and stance from the entity, then apply the style. Nothing cropped.
context_prompt: full-body view of the character head to toe, standing pose that shows silhouette and costume, feet on a simple ground plane, watercolour picture-book illustration, soft pencil line, loose washes that bleed past the line, visible paper texture, gentle rounded shapes, pastel palette, soft daylight, white paper showing through the highlights
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, harsh black outlines, neon colours, dark horror mood, text, watermark
